title: Generic LLM Provider Entry
description: One generic provider entry (not a complete global LLM configuration). Describes the serde shape of LlmProviderConfig::Generic and the policy fields shared with the existing provider variants. Hand-maintained in this repository; it is not generated and is not loaded by library code.

service.description: Native LLM service protocol to target.

api_key.description: Explicit API key for the selected service. Values are never discovered from the environment.

default_model.description: Explicit default model for the selected service.

base_url.description: Optional base URL override. Defaults to the service's standard endpoint.

timeout_secs.description: Optional per-provider timeout in seconds. Positive when set.

network_retry.description: Optional shared network retry and backoff policy.

max_attempts.description: Maximum attempts before giving up. 0 means unlimited.

max_attempts_absolute.description: Optional hard cap on total attempts. Null or absent preserves max_attempts semantics.

initial_delay_ms.description: Base delay for the first retry, in milliseconds.

jitter_factor.description: Jitter factor applied to the computed delay.

pricing.description: Optional shared pricing table for cost estimation.

cache_ttl_secs.description: Optional response cache TTL in seconds. Positive when set.
